source.title: Effect of Pressure and External Heating on Microgravity and Earth Gravity Fires
source.author: Christina Liveretou
source.reviewStatus: Full file acquired; focused review of Chapters 3-6, Chapter 2 methods/results excerpts, outline, references and appendix; not a claim that every background page was reviewed.
source.rights: No redistribution license established in this review; PDF and page images remain local. Shared content is factual transcription and original analysis.

lineage.basis: PDF 30 / printed 18 explicitly states Chapter 4 uses Chapter 3 data.
lineage.chapter2Relation: Overlapping title, apparatus and reported conditions with LIV24; not treated as independent replication. Exact run-by-run correspondence is unestablished.
lineage.journalVersionRelation: Chapter 3 title matches the later journal article DOI 10.1016/j.firesaf.2025.104625; version-of-record equivalence and exact run correspondence have not been checked.

rodContext.externalHeating: Chapter 3 outline explicitly states no external radiant flux; not generalized to other MIST campaigns.
rodContext.gasProtocol: Recirculating depletion; initially closed ports, with occasional venting to maintain pressure. Not a constant-inventory sealed vessel throughout.
rodContext.initialOxygenNote: Generic air/21% descriptions coexist with explicit lower microgravity starts and elevated ground starts at 40/60 kPa. Per-run initial values are unavailable.
rodContext.endpoint: Chapter 3 PDF 46 / printed 34 defines LOC by visual flame extinction. Figure 15 dots instead mark the end of the spread phase. These are different endpoints.

measurementPipeline.positionMethod: Image-derived flame-front positions; exact tracking configuration, pixel-to-length calibration uncertainty and raw exports not acquired.
measurementPipeline.rateMethod: Identify spread/regression phases; separately fit degree-two position polynomials; differentiate each fit.
measurementPipeline.figure21Smoothing: Presentation only; explicitly not used for the rate calculation.
measurementPipeline.positionTimeOriginFigure14: Sample lowered into position, after ignition.
measurementPipeline.interpretation: A quadratic position model yields a linear time derivative by construction. Position fit quality alone does not validate instantaneous rates. This does not establish that the source rates are wrong.

printedMeanHeatRelease.quantity: Average heat release rate from ignition until visual flame extinction
printedMeanHeatRelease.method: Calculated using oxygen depletion and approximately 13.1 kJ per gram of oxygen consumed.
printedMeanHeatRelease.arithmeticCheckAgainstRawOxygen: NOT RUN: raw oxygen, flow/venting corrections and durations are unavailable.

separateSheetStudy.locator: Chapter 5, PDF 72-83 / printed 60-71; Tables 2-3 at PDF 79 / printed 67
separateSheetStudy.configuration: Upward concurrent spread on 0.1 mm PMMA sheets in normal gravity; forced flow 20 cm/s plus buoyancy; central tracking and a one-second window around the sample midpoint.
separateSheetStudy.nominalNormoxicRelation: Pressure times oxygen mole fraction approximately 21 kPa; printed settings are rounded. Oxygen depletes during burning.
separateSheetStudy.exponentRole: Approximate source correlations along coupled nominal pressure/oxygen settings; not raw observations, dimensional equations, fixed-oxygen pressure effects or transferable rod models.
separateSheetStudy.cottonAncestry: Prior Thomsen et al. ICES 2023 study, reference 98; not new independent PMMA observations.
separateSheetStudy.heatReleaseMethods: Chapter 5 describes mass-loss and oxygen-consumption methods. They are distinct methods sharing the experiment, not demonstrated statistically independent validations. No plotted HRR values transcribed.

unresolved.issue: Chapter 3 PDF 51/57 reports higher LOC at lower pressure. NASA FY2026 MIST Task Book summary reports lower LOC-FS and LOC-FR at lower pressure. Endpoint/run/version differences remain unresolved; no universal pressure trend inferred.
Generic 21% initial oxygen descriptions are qualified by explicit per-condition exceptions. Do not assign 21% to all runs.

PDF 68 / printed 56 Eq. 23 prints g outside the square root, whereas PDF 53 / printed 41 puts g inside. With dimensional gravitational acceleration these have different dimensions. No equation silently repaired or executed.
